marketplace.loginToCreate: Sign in to create a listing.
marketplace.author: Author

inquiry.contactHint: Send a message about this listing. The seller can reply here and may get email or SMS alerts.
inquiry.ownListing: This is your listing — open My listings to manage it.
inquiry.loginToContact: Sign in to send a message to the seller.
inquiry.messagePlaceholder: Hi, I'm interested in this listing…
inquiry.inboxSubtitle: One chat per listing — it never moves between folders when someone replies.
inquiry.inboxExplain: This is not email “Sent” or “Received”. You and the other person share the same conversation. Filters only show your role: buying someone else's ad, or selling yours.
inquiry.threadAsBuyer: You contacted the seller about this listing. All replies stay in this chat.
inquiry.threadAsSeller: A buyer contacted you about your listing. All replies stay in this chat.
inquiry.threadHint: New messages from either side appear below — nothing switches to another folder.
inquiry.emptyReceived: No messages on your listings yet.
inquiry.emptySent: You have not contacted any sellers yet.
inquiry.notifyHint: When someone contacts you about this listing. Later you can set defaults in account preferences.
inquiry.notifyEmail: Email me when I receive a new message
inquiry.notifySms: SMS me when I receive a new message
inquiry.notifySmsServerHint: Real SMS needs Twilio in backend/.env (TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER). Without it, the API logs the text and may send a backup email.
